set.def: to carefully plan and organize a complicated event or effort, often from behind the scenes
set.also: to arrange a piece of music so that a large group of instruments can play it (“She orchestrated the folk song for a full symphony.”)

why: also-def contained 'orchestra' (obvious form of the term, giveaway in test g); band example wrong; 'often secretly' overstated
